source_text.body:
Find unclaimed government money and negotiate bills
A founder pitches a background agent that searches for unclaimed government money under a user's name and negotiates bills to save money.
·
Nov 13, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The founder says they built an AI agent for foundmoney that runs continuously and is meant to search for unclaimed government money under a user's name, negotiate bills, and handle many other saving tasks. In the comments, they add one concrete control detail: the user takes the final step, and can manage settings for each stage from a dashboard.
How it went
The thread gives no examples, metrics, or reported savings, so the outcome is only a product pitch. The only stated limitation is that bill changes are not accepted autonomously without the user's final approval.
Worth knowing
The main catch mentioned is approval flow: even if the agent negotiates, the user keeps the final say and can configure each stage in the dashboard.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Search official unclaimed property databases, such as [my state's site] and the national lookup, for money under the name [full name], including past names [former names] and past addresses [cities]. Give me a list of each match with the amount, holder, and claim link. Don't submit any claim forms or enter my personal ID details; pause and show me before taking any such step.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/SideProject/comments/1xtemxy/let_ai_agent_find_and_negotiate_for_you
